props.type_help.text: Any text on one line, optionally with a format (regular expression).
props.type_help.email: An e-mail address, shown as a link.
props.type_help.phone: A phone number, shown as a link to call.
props.type_help.url: An http(s) address, mailto: or a path of the wiki.
props.type_help.code: A short identifier, optionally with a format, e.g. [A-Z]{3}-[0-9]{4}.
props.type_help.language: A language code such as de or en-GB.
props.type_help.country: A country code such as AT, shown with its name.
props.type_help.integer: A whole number, optionally with minimum, maximum and unit.
props.type_help.decimal: A number with decimals (comma or point).
props.type_help.currency: An amount in a currency (two decimals).
props.type_help.unit: A measurement such as 12.5 kg or 3 m².
props.type_help.rating: A rating from 0 to the number of stars.
props.type_help.progress: Progress from 0 to 100 %, shown as a bar.
props.type_help.date: A day; filters understand today, today+30d, today-1m.
props.type_help.daterange: From one date to another; shown in calendar and timeline.
props.type_help.status: One of the choices, shown as a coloured label (also for boards).
props.type_help.user: One or more people of the wiki.
props.type_help.element: Other elements of the wiki (only shown to readers who may see them).
props.type_help.media: A file of the media library.
props.type_help.location: An address, optionally with coordinates (link to the map).
props.type_help.version: A version number such as 1.4.2 (sorted correctly).
props.type_help.autonumber: Each new element gets the next number, e.g. REQ-0042.
props.type_help.formula: Computed from other properties, e.g. price * quantity.
props.builtin.title: Title
props.src.help: Elements of all sources are shown together, each once. Without a source: this category with its subcategories.
props.flt.text_help: Separated by ;, e.g. status in Open,Review; due <= today+30d; owner = me; budget between 100..500; notes empty
props.opt.currency_help: ISO code such as EUR, CHF, USD
props.opt.pattern_help: The whole value must match, e.g. [A-Z]{2}[0-9]{4}
props.opt.formula_help: Keys of number or date properties (dates in days), + - * / %, comparisons, && ||, and min, max, round(x, 2), abs, floor, ceil, sqrt, if(condition, then, else). Example: round(done / total * 100)
props.title: Properties
props.global_help: Properties defined here apply to every element of the site. Categories can add their own and replace these for their elements.
props.category_help: Properties of this category apply to its elements and those of all subcategories (they can replace them). Global and inherited ones are listed too.
props.def_deleted: Definition removed; the values stay as free properties.
props.def_delete_confirm: Remove the definition “{name}”? The values of elements stay (as free properties).
props.def_where_category: For this category and its subcategories.
props.def_where_global: For all elements of the site.
props.key_help: Lower-case letters, digits and _, e.g. due_date. Used in filters and formulas; cannot be changed later.
props.label: Name
props.required_help: Must be filled in when saving.
props.show_on_page_help: In the properties above the content.
props.more_settings: More settings: group, order, element types, permissions
props.group_help: Properties with the same group are shown together.
props.view_subjects_help: Empty: everyone who sees the element. Otherwise only these (and administrators) — also in reports, filters and sums.
props.edit_subjects_help: Empty: everyone who may edit the element. Otherwise only these.
props.choices_help: The value is stored; names per language are shown (empty: the value).
props.free_help: Authors may add properties without a definition (now: {now}).
props.free_global_help: Whether authors may add free properties is set per category (default: allowed; plugin setting “free”).
props.name: Name
props.name_help: E.g. Room or Contact; the key is made from it.
props.range_order: {name}: the end is before the start.
props.computed_formula: Computed from other properties when saving.
props.choose_columns: Choose the properties to check as columns.
props.no_location: Choose a location property as a column.
props.cols_help: The order of the checked properties is the order of the columns.
props.db.choose_group: Choose a grouping for the chart.
props.db.share_view: For all readers of this database
props.db.share_view_help: Otherwise only you see this view.
props.sub.help: You get the report by e-mail – always with your current permissions. Confidential entries come with title and link only, strictly confidential ones not at all.
